rahmen.agent_hinweis: The fahnas-agent service is not responding. Check via SSH with “systemctl status fahnas-agent” and “journalctl -u fahnas-agent”. The interface reconnects automatically.
rahmen.verbindung_hinweis: Live data is not coming through right now. The interface keeps retrying automatically.
rahmen.ansicht_fehlt: This view is not available yet
rahmen.ansicht_fehlt_text: The view “{id}” could not be loaded. It belongs to a part that has not been built yet, or the file is missing.
rahmen.notfall_hinweis: Until then you can manage the NAS via SSH. The configuration is in /data/config.
rahmen.keine_verbindung_hinweis: The web service is not responding. Check that the NAS is running and reachable on the network.
rahmen.platte_voll: The data disk is almost full ({prozent}). Free up space so snapshots and uploads keep working.
navigation.favoriten_leer: None yet – mark a folder in “Files” with the star.
fehler.E_RECHTE: You don't have permission to do that.
fehler.E_ANMELDUNG: You are not signed in or the credentials are incorrect.
fehler.E_TOTP: The verification code is incorrect or missing.
fehler.E_BREMSE: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
fehler.E_CSRF: The session has expired. Please reload the page.
fehler.E_BELEGT: The name or path is already in use.
fehler.E_KONFIG: The configuration is invalid or could not be written.
fehler.E_RENDER: The setting could not be applied to the system.
fehler.E_PLATZ: Out of space – the disk or quota is full.
fehler.E_TICKET: The transfer has expired. Please try again.
fehler.E_GEAENDERT: The file has been changed in the meantime
fehler.netz: No connection to the NAS. Check the network.
fehler.zu_gross: The file is too large for the preview.
fehler.proxy_zu_gross: The file is too large for the path to the NAS: a proxy in front of it (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) rejected it (HTTP 413). Remove the upload limit there (client_max_body_size 0) or upload directly via the NAS address.
darstellung.theme_erklaerung: Colours of the interface – only for your account, on every device.
darstellung.akzent_erklaerung: Colour for buttons, highlights and the background pattern.
darstellung.hintergrund_erklaerung: Animated pattern like in allinone or your own wallpaper. The animation pauses in background tabs.
darstellung.tapete_erklaerung: Pick a wallpaper from your collection or from a folder on the NAS. Pictures, animated GIF/WebP and videos (MP4/WebM, muted, looped) are supported.
darstellung.tapete_eigene_erklaerung: Uploaded files stay in your account only, up to 300 MB each. Click a picture to set it as wallpaper.
darstellung.tapete_voll: At most {max} own wallpapers – please remove one first
darstellung.tapete_ordner_erklaerung: Every picture and video in this folder can be picked. Just drop new files there via the file manager or the network; they are read with your permissions.
darstellung.tapete_ordner_neu_titel: Read the folder again, e.g. after adding new files
darstellung.tapete_ordner_leer: This folder holds no pictures or videos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, MP4, WebM).
darstellung.tapete_ordner_keine_unter: No subfolders – take it with “Use this folder”.
darstellung.skalierung_erklaerung: How the wallpaper is fitted to the screen. Empty edges show the theme colour.
darstellung.sk_auto_text: Automatic – always shows the whole picture and fills the screen: small aspect-ratio differences are evened out invisibly, otherwise a blurred copy fills the edge. Adapts to every window size.
darstellung.sk_fuellen_text: Fill – covers the whole screen, overhanging edges are cropped.
darstellung.sk_einpassen_text: Fit – the whole wallpaper stays visible, possibly with empty edges.
darstellung.sk_strecken_text: Stretch – pulled to screen size, the aspect ratio may distort.
darstellung.sk_mitte_text: Centre – original size in the middle, nothing is scaled.
darstellung.sk_kacheln_text: Tile – the picture repeats at original size, good for patterns.
darstellung.zoom_erklaerung: Enlarges or shrinks the wallpaper towards the centre of the screen. 100 % = as the scaling shows it on the NAS screen.
darstellung.zoom_normal: {n} % – exactly as the scaling, nothing enlarged
darstellung.zoom_gross: {n} % – enlarged: a section from the centre, the edges are cropped
darstellung.zoom_klein: {n} % – reduced: the theme colour shows all around
darstellung.zoom_auto: Not needed with “Automatic” – the whole picture always fits. Choose another scaling to zoom.
darstellung.abdunkeln_kaum: {n} % – vivid wallpaper, text may be harder to read
darstellung.glas_erklaerung: Header, navigation, cards and windows become translucent like on macOS/iOS. If “Reduce transparency” is on for your device, everything stays opaque.
darstellung.glas_dezent: {n} % – subtle: frosted glass, surfaces almost opaque
darstellung.glas_klar: {n} % – clear: the background shows through clearly
fehler.kopieren_fehl: Copying not possible – please select and copy the details.
fehler.hilfe_E_PARAMS: An entry does not fit. Check the marked field and the explanation below it – usually something is missing or a character is not allowed.
fehler.hilfe_E_RECHTE: Only an admin may do this. Sign in with an admin account or ask an admin.
fehler.hilfe_E_ANMELDUNG: Sign in again. If the password is surely right, check Caps Lock.
fehler.hilfe_E_TOTP: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If your phone’s clock is wrong, set it to “automatic”.
fehler.hilfe_E_BREMSE: To protect against attacks, sign-in is blocked briefly. Wait a minute and try again.
fehler.hilfe_E_CSRF: Reload the page (F5 or ⌘R) and try again.
fehler.hilfe_E_NICHT_GEFUNDEN: It has been deleted, renamed or unplugged in the meantime. Reload the page.
fehler.hilfe_E_EXISTIERT: The name is already taken. Choose a different name.
fehler.hilfe_E_BELEGT: It is still in use – e.g. open files, a running app or a computer accessing it. Close that and try again.
fehler.hilfe_E_KONFIG: The settings could not be saved. Check on the dashboard whether the disk is full and try again.
fehler.hilfe_E_RENDER: The system rejected the setting; the previous state stays active. The technical details show the reason.
fehler.hilfe_E_SYSTEM: A system command failed. The technical details show its output. If trying again does not help, check the log.
fehler.hilfe_E_PLATZ: Storage is full. Empty recycle bins, delete old snapshots or large files – or extend the storage.
fehler.hilfe_E_AGENT: The control service is restarting or stuck. Wait a minute; if it stays like this, restart the NAS.
fehler.hilfe_E_TICKET: The transfer took too long. Simply start it again.
fehler.hilfe_E_GEAENDERT: Someone saved the file while you had it open. Save your version as a copy or reload.
fehler.hilfe_E_ABGEBROCHEN: The operation was cancelled. You can start it again at any time.
fehler.hilfe_E_UNBEKANNT: Try again. If the error happens again, copy the technical details and check the log.
fehler.hilfe_netz: Check that your device is on the same network or connected via VPN and that the NAS is switched on.
abmelden.erklaerung: How long without use before you are signed out. Applies to all your devices right away.
abmelden.text_standard: Default – after 12 hours without use, with “Stay signed in” at sign-in after 30 days.
abmelden.text_zeit: After {dauer} without use – closing the browser doesn't sign you out earlier.
abmelden.text_nie: Never – you stay signed in until you sign out yourself. Only choose this on your own devices.
